import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_K = 33;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] a = new long[MAX_K + 1][MAX_K + 1];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_K; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(a[i], 0);
            }
        }
    }

    static Matrix multiply(Matrix m1, Matrix m2, int size) {
        Matrix result = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= size; j++) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int p = 0; p <= size; p++) {
                    sum += m1.a[i][p] * m2.a[p][j];
                }
                result.a[i][j] = sum % MOD;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        Matrix ans = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            ans.a[i][i] = 1;
        }

        List<Matrix> t = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int p = 0; p < k; p++) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    if (i == j || i == p) {
                        mat.a[i][j] = 1;
                    } else {
                        mat.a[i][j] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            t.add(mat);
        }

        List<Long> bits = new ArrayList<>();
        long temp = n;
        while (temp > 0) {
            bits.add(temp % k);
            temp /= k;
        }
        bits.add(0);
        Collections.reverse(bits);
        // partial sum
        for (int i = 1; i < bits.size(); i++) {
            bits.set(i, bits.get(i) + bits.get(i - 1));
        }

        for (int p = 0; p + 1 < bits.size(); p++) {
            for (int i = (int) (bits.get(p) - 1); i >= bits.get(p + 1); i--) {
                ans = multiply(t.get(i % k), ans, k);
            }
            List<Matrix> pre = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Matrix> suf = new ArrayList<>();
            pre.add(t.get(0));
            for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                pre.add(multiply(pre.get(i - 1), t.get(i), k));
            }
            suf.add(t.get(k - 1));
            for (int i = k - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
                suf.add(0, multiply(t.get(i), suf.get(0), k));
            }
            ans = multiply(suf.get(0), ans, k);
            for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                ans = multiply(suf.get(i), pre.get(i - 1), k);
            }
        }

        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            total += ans.a[i][k];
        }
        System.out.println(total % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }
}
